author: FOX 23 Tulsa KOKI
title: Tulsa Mayor Nichols tours Oklahoma Technical College - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago TULSA, Okla. — Tulsa Mayor Monroe Nichols took a tour of Oklahoma Technical College on Wednesday.
"We are excited to have an honored guest here today with us, Mayor Nichols," said Dr. Kimberly Sebastian, the President of HigherEd Institute. "We've asked him to come tour the school today to learn a little bit about our programs and what we have to offer in skilled trades. We offer plumbing, HVAC, electrical, diesel, automotive."
Dr. Sebastian explained the main part of the school that was highlighted on the tour.
"We're going to take a look at our hands-on learning labs. While we do offer classroom settings, it's most important that individuals are getting hands-on technical training so that they are ready for the career and for the industry."
Dr. Sebastian said she hoped the tour would serve as a chance to show Tulsa's mayor how Oklahoma Technical College is positively impacting the community.
"We have been established since 2009 and we are a vital part of the Tulsa community and I hope that he has the opportunity to see the difference that we're making throughout the community."
According to Dr. Sebastian, Oklahoma Technical College offers over $850,000 in scholarships to students annually.
